annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes a full-time Bitcoin income opportunity, offering a $2 incentive to get friends to open Coinbase accounts and put in $100, then moving those contacts into Bitclub Network mining. He presents this recruitment pathway as lucrative, claims about $10,000 in a little over two months, and invites viewers to contact him and join; the earnings pitch is explicitly tied to bringing people into the network, not simply to a standalone wallet tutorial or one-level referral.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the speaker describes recruiting contacts into Coinbase and then Bitclub Network mining as his income-generating activity, and directly invites viewers to replicate that opportunity. The cited material establishes recruitment-dependent promotion, though it does not establish a multi-level hierarchy or qualification tiers.
